quarterly_data.signal: Alibaba's announcement: the U.S. Department of Defense has included Alibaba Group in its list of Chinese Military Companies (the CMC List); the Department of Defense is prohibited from procuring, directly or indirectly, goods, services or technology from entities on the CMC List. The company believes its inclusion is a mistake, says there is no basis to place it on the list and that it is not a Chinese military company nor part of any military-civil fusion strategy, and says it will take all available legal action against attempts to misrepresent the company. It says the inclusion will not affect the group's ability to conduct business as usual in the United States or anywhere in the world because the group does not do business related to U.S. military procurement, and that the CMC List does not impose any other export controls or sanctions, nor prohibit any persons other than the Department of Defense from business dealings with the group or transacting in its securities.
